meta.title: Terms of Service · Ziwei Natal Chart
meta.description: Terms of service and user agreement for Ziwei Natal Chart

overview.heading: 1. Service Overview
overview.body: Ziwei Natal Chart (“this site”) provides natal chart calculation and reading services based on the Ziwei Doushu (Purple Star Astrology) system in Ni Haixia’s Tian Ji. All astrological content on this site is for reference only and does not constitute any medical, investment, legal or psychological counseling advice, or advice on major life decisions.

conduct.heading: 2. User Conduct
conduct.intro: By using this site, you agree:
conduct.lawfulUse: to use this site only for lawful, personal reference purposes
conduct.noRedistribution: not to distribute this site’s content for commercial sale, reposting or public release
conduct.noDisruption: not to engage in any conduct that disrupts this site’s normal operation
conduct.truthfulBirthInfo: that the birth information you submit is true and valid; this site is not responsible for inaccurate readings caused by incorrect information

ip.heading: 3. Intellectual Property and Restrictions on Use
ip.ownership: Original text and interface design on this site are protected by copyright. The charting engine comes from an open-source project and is used under its open-source license; the classics are public-domain Ming dynasty editions, presented here as modern summaries.
ip.scraping: (1) scrape this site’s content with crawlers, automated scripts or bulk API calls;
ip.training: (2) use readings, text or API responses generated by this site to train machine learning models;
ip.resale: (3) resell content generated by this site.
ip.penalty: If you breach these terms, we reserve the right to take legal action.

disclaimer.heading: 4. Disclaimer
disclaimer.accuracy: This site’s astrological content is compiled from knowledge of traditional Ziwei Doushu and Ni Haixia’s system, and is not guaranteed to be 100% accurate. Destiny is influenced jointly by the Three Powers of heaven, earth and humanity, and this site’s output serves only as a reference for understanding yourself. Users should view it rationally and should not rely too heavily on any single astrological judgment.
disclaimer.liability: This site bears no legal liability for any consequences arising from the use of its content (including but not limited to mistaken decisions, psychological effects and changes in relationships).

changes.heading: 5. Service Changes and Termination
changes.body: This site reserves the right to adjust, suspend or terminate some or all of its services at any time. Major changes will be announced on this site.

law.heading: 6. Governing Law, Arbitration and Dispute Resolution
law.a: (a) Governing law. In this section, “we” means the operator of this site. These Terms are governed by and construed under the laws of the State of California, United States, without regard to its conflict-of-laws rules. The Federal Arbitration Act governs the arbitration provisions in this section.
law.b: (b) Informal resolution first. If a dispute arises from or relates to these Terms or this site, the parties shall first try to settle it amicably. The party raising the dispute shall send the other a written notice describing it; you can reach us at the contact details in Section 7. If the dispute is not resolved within 60 days after the notice is received, either party may start arbitration as described below.
law.c: (c) Binding arbitration. Except as provided in (e), any unresolved dispute shall be finally resolved by binding individual arbitration administered by the American Arbitration Association (AAA) under its Consumer Arbitration Rules then in effect, before a single arbitrator. Hearings may be held by video or telephone, or in person in San Francisco County, California, or, if you live in the United States, in the county where you live. The arbitrator may award the same individual relief a court could. Judgment on the award may be entered in any court with jurisdiction.
law.d: (d) Fees. We will pay all AAA filing, administrative and arbitrator fees beyond what you would pay to file a claim in court, and we will pay them on time as California law requires. Each party bears its own attorneys’ fees unless applicable law or the AAA rules provide otherwise.
law.e: (e) Exceptions. Either party may bring a qualifying individual claim in small claims court. A claim for public injunctive relief under California law may be brought in court, and it shall be stayed until the arbitrable claims are decided. Nothing in this section limits any consumer rights you have under the laws of your place of residence that cannot be waived by contract.
law.f: (f) No class actions. To the extent permitted by law, claims may be brought only individually, not as a plaintiff or class member in any purported class, collective or representative proceeding, and the arbitrator may not consolidate the claims of more than one person. If this paragraph is found unenforceable for a claim, that claim shall proceed in court, not in class arbitration.
law.g: (g) Your right to opt out. You may opt out of this arbitration agreement by emailing us at the address in Section 7, within 30 days after you first use this site after these Terms take effect, with your name and a statement that you opt out of arbitration. Opting out does not affect any other part of these Terms.
law.h: (h) Courts. Any dispute that is not arbitrated shall be brought in the state or federal courts located in San Francisco County, California, and both parties consent to the jurisdiction of those courts. That includes small claims, public injunctive relief, the claims of anyone who opted out, and actions to confirm or set aside an award.
law.i: (i) Severability. If any part of this section is found unenforceable, the rest remains in effect, except as stated in (f).

contact.heading: 7. Contact
contact.body: If you have any questions, contact us on WeChat ({wechat}) or by email at {email}.

meta.title: Privacy Policy · Ziwei Natal Chart
meta.description: Privacy policy for Ziwei Natal Chart

collect.heading: 1. Information We Collect
collect.intro: To build your chart and write its reading, this site handles the following information:
collect.chart: Birth details: a name (optional), date of birth in the Gregorian calendar, time of birth, gender and place of birth. The chart is calculated in your browser.
collect.account: Account: no sign-up is needed today. We will update this policy before sign-in launches.
collect.questions: Questions: what you type into the reading panel.
collect.analytics: Usage statistics: Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights record anonymous page views and performance data, without cookies that identify you.

use.heading: 2. How We Use Information
use.chart: Birth details are used only to build your chart and write this reading; the site does not store them on its servers.
use.analytics: Anonymous usage statistics are used only to improve the site.

sharing.heading: 3. Information Sharing and Third Parties
sharing.intro: We do not share your personal information with third parties except in the following cases:
sharing.hosting: Hosting by Vercel: it serves the site and provides the anonymous usage statistics above.
sharing.ai: AI service Anthropic (Claude): when you ask for a reading, the site sends it the structure of your chart (the stars and Four Transformations in the twelve palaces, the Five Phases Configuration, your current age and decades) and your questions, to write the reading. It does not send your date or time of birth, your gender or your name.
sharing.authorities: Lawful requests from judicial authorities or government departments under laws and regulations

security.heading: 4. Information Security
security.body: The whole site uses HTTPS. Your birth details and questions are not stored on our servers. No transmission over the internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.

rights.heading: 5. Your Rights
rights.local: Local preferences: your theme and language preferences live only in your browser; clearing the site’s data deletes them.
rights.server: Server data: the site does not store your birth details or questions on its servers, so there is no personal data to access, export or delete.

cookies.heading: 6. Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.body: The site keeps only two preferences: day or night theme (in your browser’s local storage) and interface language (the NEXT_LOCALE cookie, kept for a year). It uses no tracking cookies. You can clear both in your browser settings, and the site returns to its defaults.

minors.heading: 7. Minors
minors.body: This site’s astrological content is intended for adult users aged 18 and over. Minors should use it with their guardian’s consent and must not use readings for major life decisions.

changes.heading: 8. Changes to This Policy
changes.body: This policy may be updated from time to time. We will give prominent notice of major changes. Continuing to use this site means you agree to the updated version.
